features.text: When combat begins, place a duplicate within Close range of the Doppelhound. The Doppelhound occupies both its place and its duplicate’s. The duplicate can move when the Doppelhound is spotlighted, and the Doppelhound can target enemies with attacks as if it were in its duplicate’s place. When the Doppelhound or duplicate is attacked, the attacker rolls a d6. On an even result, they target the Doppelhound. On an odd result, they target the duplicate, and the attack fails. If an attack succeeds against the Doppelhound, the duplicate is dispelled until you spend a Fear to conjure it again.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

adversaries.name: Dragon Knight
adversaries.description: A knight clad in dragonplate armor and a helmet in the shape of a dragon’s head.

features.name: High Ground
features.text: The Knight gains advantage on attacks made against targets below them.

features.name: Leaping Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Knight leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make a standard attack against them. On a success, the attack deals an extra 1d12 damage, and the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

features.name: Comeback
features.text: When the Knight fails a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to reroll the attack with advantage.

adversaries.name: Electric Eels
adversaries.description: A swarm of eels that encircle and electrocute.

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Eels have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Paralyzing Shock
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range. You gain a Fear for each target that marks HP.

adversaries.name: Elephant
adversaries.description: A huge pachyderm that has large ears and a prehensile trunk.

features.name: Trample
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Elephant charge up to Far range in a straight line. Each target in its path must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d10+3 physical damage.

features.name: Toss
features.text: When the Elephant makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have it toss the target to another location within Close range and deal an extra 1d12 damage.

adversaries.name: Elite Soldier
adversaries.description: An armored squire or experienced commoner looking to advance.

features.name: Reinforce
features.text: Mark a Stress to move into Melee range of an ally and make a standard attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and the ally can clear a Stress.

features.name: Vassal’s Loyalty
features.text: When the Soldier is within Very Close range of a knight or other noble who would take damage, you can mark a Stress to move into Melee range of them and take the damage instead.

adversaries.name: Entombed Cat Beast
adversaries.description: A large undead humanoid skeleton with a panther’s skull for a head.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Cat Beast can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Bloody Strike
features.text: A PC who marks 3 or more HP from an attack made by the Cat Beast must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Screeching Caterwaul
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range of the Cat Beast to make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail become Rattled until they roll with Hope. When the Cat Beast makes a successful attack against a Rattled PC, roll damage twice and take the better result, then clear the Rattled condition from the target.

features.name: I Alone
features.text: When the Cat Beast first appears, you can choose to have them absorb the essence of their allies. Immediately defeat any number of allies on the battlefield, and gain a Fear for each ally defeated this way.

features.name: Vicious Reprisal
features.text: When the Cat Beast takes damage from an attack made by a PC within Very Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against that PC.

adversaries.name: Entombed Elite Guard
adversaries.description: An elite undead soldier buried with their empress to defend the tomb from theft and desecration.

features.name: Battle Formation
features.text: The Guard gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty for each ally within Very Close range.

features.name: Javelin
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Far range. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Entombed Empress
adversaries.description: The undead ruler of a forgotten realm. She’s been given blasphemous funeral rites to prevent her soul from moving on.

features.name: Empty Husk
features.text: The Empress has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Missing Organs
features.text: The Empress’s internal organs have been removed and placed into six crystal containers hidden throughout her tomb. Each time the PCs find and destroy one, the Empress marks a HP.

features.name: Grasping Chains
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Empress target a creature within Close range and try to telekinetically bind them with her funeral chains. Make an attack against a target within Close range. On a success, the Empress pulls the target into Melee range, deals 2d8 physical damage, and temporarily Restrains them.

features.name: Deathless Obedience
features.text: Up to three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to spotlight any number of allies within Close range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Accursed Caress
features.text: When the Empress makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to activate a Doom Countdown (1d6+1) for that PC. It ticks down when a PC rolls with Fear. When it triggers, the PC marks all HP and makes a death move. If the Empress is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

features.name: Final Transformation (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Empress marks her last HP, replace her with the Entombed Cat Beast and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Entombed Necropriest
adversaries.description: A necromancer charged with preserving the empress’s life beyond death.

features.name: Invigorate
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose up to three allies within Far range. Each one gains advantage on their next attack roll.

features.name: Last Grasp
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. Skeletal hands burst out of the ground at the PC’s feet and Restrain them until the PC breaks free with a successful Strength Roll. When a target Restrained in this way spends Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Chill Touch
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes standard damage and must mark 1d4 Stress. If the target marks their last Stress from this attack, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Entombed Skin Beetles
adversaries.description: Flesh-eating beetles that burrow beneath the skin.

features.name: Horde (2d4+1)
features.text: When the Beetles have marked half or more of their HP, their standard attack deals 2d4+1 physical damage instead.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Beetles make a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Omophagous
features.text: Mark a HP to have 5 Beetles burrow under the skin of a PC within Melee range, forcing them to mark a Stress and Infecting them. While Infected, the target takes 6 direct physical damage every time they roll with Fear. This condition is cleared when the PC clears a HP or a Stress.

adversaries.name: Entombed Stonemason
adversaries.description: An unfortunate undead laborer chosen by lottery to wall up their empress’s tomb from the inside.

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Stonemason is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Stonemason, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range their attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Entombed Stonemasons within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: The Work Never Ends
features.text: When the Stonemason is defeated by an attack that deals physical damage, you can spend a Fear to clear the Stonemason’s HP and Stress.

adversaries.name: Failed Experiment
adversaries.description: A magical necromantic experiment gone wrong, leaving them warped and ungainly.

features.name: Warped Fortitude
features.text: The Experiment is resistant to physical damage.

features.name: Overwhelm
features.text: When a target the Experiment attacks has other adversaries within Very Close range, the Experiment deals double damage.

features.name: Lurching Lunge
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight the Experiment as an additional GM move instead of spending Fear.

adversaries.name: Flock of Feather Fiends
adversaries.description: A flock of undead crow corpses, eyes aglow with necroplasmic light.

features.name: Horde (1d6+1)
features.text: When the Flock has marked half or more of its HP, its standard attack deals 1d6+1 magic damage instead.

features.name: Maddening Cacophony
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Very Close range to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must spend a Hope or become Vulnerable until they deal damage to the Flock or the Flock is defeated.

adversaries.name: Fowlbear
adversaries.description: A grizzly bear with a feathery hide and the head of a giant goose.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Fowlbear can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Double Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Dread Honk
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fowlbear unleash a terrifying, ear-splitting goose honk. Each PC within Close range must make a Presence Reaction Roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress, move away from the Fowlbear to Far range, and become Vulnerable until the Fowlbear deals damage to them. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or move away from the Fowlbear to Far range.

adversaries.name: Fungispunj Sporeling
adversaries.description: A halfling-sized mushroom creature that defends itself from attackers with tiny puffs of neurotoxic spores.

features.name: Minion (6)
features.text: The Sporeling is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 6 damage a PC deals to the Sporeling, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 4 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Form Up
features.text: Spend a Fear to combine three Sporelings within a Close area and replace them with a Fungispunj Sporophore.

adversaries.name: Fungispunj Sporophore
adversaries.description: A giant mushroom creature that can command the dead.

features.name: Neurotoxic Spore Cloud
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Sporophore spray a cloud of spores on all targets within Close range. Each PC must succeed on a Agility Reaction Roll or become Poisoned until they spend a Hope to clear the condition. While Poisoned, a target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 4 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

features.name: Reanimator
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Sporophore spray a corpse within Very Close range with a cloud of psychic spores. The corpse clears all HP and Stress, then reanimates under the psychic control of the Sporophore. When the Sporophore is spotlighted, you can also spotlight all corpses it controls.

features.name: Colony
features.text: Mark any number of Stress to have the Sporophore summon an equal number of Fungispunj Sporelings within Close range.

features.name: Mind Meld
features.text: All Fungispunj can telepathically communicate with one another. When the Sporophore would be forced to mark Stress from an attack, it can cause Fungispunj allies in the scene to mark that Stress in its place, distributed among allies as it chooses.

adversaries.name: Gargoyle
adversaries.description: A magically animated statue resembling a terrifying beast or demon.

features.name: Unliving
features.text: The Gargoyle has resistance to magic damage.

features.name: Swooping Strike
features.text: Choose a point within Far range. The Gargoyle moves to that point and makes a standard attack against one target along its path.

features.name: Petrifying Slash
features.text: When the Gargoyle deals damage, the target must succeed on a Strength Reaction Roll or become Vulnerable. If the target is already Vulnerable, they become Restrained. If the target is already Vulnerable and Restrained, they must make a death move. The PC can spend a Hope per condition to clear it.

adversaries.name: Giant Beastmaster
adversaries.description: A leather-clad warrior bearing a whip and massive bow.

features.name: Two as One
features.text: When the Beastmaster is spotlighted, you can also spotlight a Tier 1 animal adversary currently under their control.

features.name: Pinning Strike
features.text: Make a standard attack against a target. On a success, you can mark a Stress to pin them to a nearby surface. The pinned target is Restrained until they break free with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll.

features.name: Deadly Companion
features.text: Twice per scene, summon a Bear, Dire Wolf, or similar Tier 1 animal adversary under the Beastmaster’s control. The adversary appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Giant Brawler
adversaries.description: An especially muscular giant wielding a warhammer larger than a human.

features.name: Battering Ram
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Brawler charge at an inanimate object within Close range they could feasibly smash (such as a wall, cart, or market stand) and destroy it. All targets within Very Close range of the object must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d4+3 physical damage from the shrapnel.

features.name: Bloody Reprisal
features.text: When the Brawler marks 2 or more HP from an attack within Very Close range, you can make a standard attack against the attacker. On a success, the Brawler deals 2d6+15 physical damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Brawler makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Giant Eagle
adversaries.description: A giant bird of prey with blood-stained talons.

features.name: Flight
features.text: While flying, the Eagle gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Deadly Dive
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, deal 2d10+2 physical damage and knock the target over, making them Vulnerable until they next act.

features.name: Take Off
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+3 physical damage and the target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or become temporarily Restrained within the Eagle’s massive talons. If the target is Restrained, the Eagle immediately lifts into the air to Very Far range above the battlefield while holding them.

features.name: Deadly Drop
features.text: While flying, the Eagle can drop a Restrained target they are holding. When dropped, the target is no longer Restrained but starts falling. If their fall isn’t prevented during the PCs’ next action, the target takes 2d20 physical damage when they land.

adversaries.name: Giant Octopus
adversaries.description: A monstrous, aquatic mollusk that has eight sucker-bearing arms and a hard, beaklike jaw.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Octopus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Armed and Dangerous
features.text: When the Octopus first appears, place a d8 on this stat block with the 8 value facing up. When the Octopus makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can add the die’s value to the damage dealt. After you add its value to a roll, decrease the die’s value by 1.

features.name: Grapple
features.text: When the Octopus succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to have the Octopus Grapple the target. While Grappled, the target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll.

features.name: Crush
features.text: Mark a Stress to deal 3d8 direct physical damage to a target Grappled by the Octopus.

adversaries.name: Giant Recruit
adversaries.description: A giant fighter wearing borrowed armor.

features.name: Minion (7)
features.text: The Recruit is defeated when they take any damage. For every 7 damage a PC deals to the Recruit, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Giant Recruits within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Gobstalker
adversaries.description: A fleshy, floating ball of teeth that has numerous eyes and a bundle of questing mouth tentacles that shoot magic beams.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Gobstalker can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Anti-Mystica-Halitosis
features.text: The Gobstalker’s rancid breath creates an invisible, magic-negating miasma. An attack, an ability, or a spell that deals magic damage or creates a magic effect fails automatically if used within Close range of the Gobstalker.

features.name: Tentacle Rays
features.text:
Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, roll a d8 for a random beam attack or spend a Fear to choose instead:
1. Beguile. The Gobstalker Beguiles the target. While Beguiled, the target sees the Gobstalker as a friend and can’t attack it. Additionally, when a PC rolls with Fear, a Beguiled PC must mark a Stress or attack a target chosen by the Gobstalker. A Beguiled PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) to clear the condition.
2. Corrode. The target takes 2d8 magic damage and must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t, double the damage.
3. Doom. The target must mark all HP, but they can spend any number of Hope to reduce the number of HP marked this way by an equal amount.
4. Hypnosis. The target falls into a Deep Trance and can’t act except to try to wake up. This condition lasts until the target takes damage or wakes up with a successful Presence Roll (16).
5. Paralyze. The target freezes in place, becoming Vulnerable and Restrained until they mark 2 Stress.
6. Sear. The target takes 2d8 direct magic damage.
7. Scare. The target is Scared. While Scared, the target can’t take actions other than fleeing the battle or trying to shake off their terror. Additionally, the target must mark a Stress whenever you spend a Fear. The target can clear the condition with a successful Presence Roll (16).
8. Slow. The target becomes Vulnerable and must mark a Stress to move until they spend 2 Hope.

features.name: Leech Lick
features.text: On a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to clear a number of Stress equal to the number of HP the target marked.

adversaries.name: Gorgon
adversaries.description: A snake-headed, scaled humanoid with a gilded bow, enraged that their peace has been disturbed.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Gorgon can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Sunsear Arrows
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful standard attack, the target Glows until the end of the scene and can’t become Hidden. Attack rolls made against a Glowing target have advantage.

features.name: Crown of Serpents
features.text: Make an attack roll against a target within Melee range using the Gorgon’s protective snakes. On a success, mark a Stress to deal 2d10+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Petrifying Gaze
features.text: When the Gorgon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can spend a Fear to force the attacker to make an Instinct Reaction Roll. On a failure, they begin to turn to stone, marking a HP and starting a Petrification Countdown (4). This countdown ticks down when the Gorgon is attacked. When it triggers, the target must make a death move. If the Gorgon is defeated, all petrification countdowns end.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Gorgon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Alebrujo
adversaries.description: A huge, colorful, chimeric beast formed from many animals.

features.name: The Beast Unleashed
features.text: The Alebrujo gains a bonus to damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Guahalan Sacrifice
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Alebrujo devour a Minion within Very Close range, then clear a HP or a Stress.

features.name: Howl of the Guahala
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Alebrujo emit a howl. Each PC within Far range must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or become temporarily Panicked. While Panicked, a PC must mark a Stress when they take the spotlight.

features.name: Rip & Tear
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage. On a success, you can mark a Stress to make another standard attack against an additional target within range. You can continue marking Stress to make additional attacks until the Alebrujo fails an attack roll.

features.name: Brutal Spectacle
features.text: When the Alebrujo deals Severe damage, you can spend a Fear to force all targets within Close range to mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Fang Lord
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting warlord who leads a group of warriors into battle.

features.name: Pack Alpha
features.text: Pool. When the Fang Lord makes a successful attack, add a token to the Guahalan Pool. When a Guahalan ally within Close range makes an attack, you can spend a token from the Guahalan Pool to give them advantage on the roll.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Fang Lord adopt a bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Call of the Guahala
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight all Guahalan Shifters within Close range. Each one makes a standard attack against a target within range. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Feral Form (Phase Change)
features.text: When the Fang Lord marks their last HP, replace them with the Guahalan Alebrujo and immediately spotlight them.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Shifter
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting masked warrior who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Shifter adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Pack Attack
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack. On a success, the attack gains a bonus to damage equal to the number of other Shifters within Very Close range of the target.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Spirit Beast
adversaries.description: A brightly colored spirit in the shape of an animal.

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Spirit Beast is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Spirit Beast, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Ethereal Form
features.text: The Spirit Beast has resistance to physical damage.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 magic damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Beast Bomb
features.text: When the Spirit Beast is defeated, it explodes in white flame and deals 5 magic damage to creatures within Melee range.

adversaries.name: Guahalan Spirit Singer
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting summoner who has animalistic features.

features.name: Unleash the Beast
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer adopt a more bestial form. While in this form, they gain a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress they have marked. Additionally, they can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Beast-Caller
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Spirit Singer summon 2d4 Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and immediately spotlight one.

features.name: Rage of Spirits
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight any number of Guahalan Spirit Beasts within Very Close range and have each one move into Melee range with the nearest PC and make a standard attack. If any attacks succeed against the same target, combine their damage.

features.name: Spiritual Sacrifice
features.text: When the Spirit Singer would take damage while within Very Close range of a Guahalan Spirit Beast, you can spend a Fear to sacrifice the Spirit Beast and negate the damage.

adversaries.name: Hill Titan
adversaries.description: A goliath clad in animal skins and surrounded by a swarm of insects.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Gullible
features.text: PCs have advantage on action rolls to trick or emotionally manipulate the Titan.

features.name: Bug Swarm
features.text: PCs are Vulnerable while within Very Close range.

features.name: Mighty Swing
features.text: Spend a Fear to make a standard attack against all targets within Very Close range.

adversaries.name: Hive Walker
adversaries.description: A corpse filled with and puppeted by a colony of carrion-eating bees.

features.name: Blood Honey
features.text: The Walker disgorges thick crimson honey at all targets between it and a point within Close range. Each target in that line must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 2d8 magic damage and become temporarily Restrained as the honey hardens on them.

features.name: Bee-Ruption
features.text: When the Walker marks HP, vengeful bees erupt from its body to protect it. Each target within Very Close range must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or take 1d8 direct physical damage for each HP the Hive Walker has marked. Restrained targets automatically fail the reaction roll.

adversaries.name: Jack-o’-Lantern
adversaries.description: A floating pumpkin or other gourd that has a face carved into it. The soul trapped within it emits an eerie glow.

features.name: Minion (4)
features.text: The Jack-o’-Lantern is defeated when it takes any damage. For every 4 damage a PC deals to the Jack-o’-Lantern, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Jack-o’-Lanterns within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 6 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

features.name: Spine-Chilling Cackle
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range rolls with Fear, you can mark a Stress to gain an additional Fear.

adversaries.name: Juvenile Flickerfly
adversaries.description: A horse-sized insect with iridescent scales and crystalline wings moving faster than the eye can see.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Peerless Accuracy
features.text: Before the Flickerfly makes an attack, roll a d6. On a result of 4 or higher, the target’s Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target’s fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope.

adversaries.name: Knight of the Realm
adversaries.description: A decorated soldier with heavy armor and a powerful steed.

features.name: Chevalier
features.text: While the Knight is on a mount, they gain a +2 bonus to their Difficulty. When they take Severe damage, they’re knocked from their mount and lose this benefit until they’re next spotlighted.

features.name: Heavily Armored
features.text: When the Knight takes physical damage, reduce it by 3.

features.name: Cavalry Charge
features.text: If the Knight is mounted, move up to Far range and make a standard attack against a target. On a success, deal 2d8+4 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: For the Realm!
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4+1 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

adversaries.name: Landshark
adversaries.description: A quadrupedal shark that swims through the ground.

features.name: Burrowing
features.text: The Landshark can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Landshark moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Landshark has resistance to all damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Thick-Skinned
features.text: When the Landshark would be forced to mark any number of HP, you can mark an equal number of Stress instead.

features.name: Rending Chomp
features.text: When the Landshark makes a successful attack against a PC within Melee range, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

adversaries.name: Landshark Behemoth
adversaries.description: A landshark that’s lived long enough to become a large burrowing monstrosity with steely hide and razor-sharp teeth.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Behemoth can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Deep Diver
features.text: The Behemoth can move through the ground as easily as over it. When the Behemoth moves, it can choose to burrow or surface. While underground, the Behemoth is immune to damage but can’t attack.

features.name: Steel-Skinned
features.text: All damage dealt to the Behemoth is reduced by one threshold.

features.name: Forceful Eruption
features.text: The Behemoth erupts from the ground, forcing each PC within Very Close range to succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or be knocked over, becoming Vulnerable until they make an action roll. For each PC made Vulnerable in this way, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Masked Thief
adversaries.description: A cunning thief with acrobatic skill and a flair for the dramatic.

features.name: Quick Hands
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 1d8+2 physical damage and the Thief steals one item or consumable from the target’s inventory.

features.name: Escape Plan
features.text: Mark a Stress to reveal a snare trap set anywhere on the battlefield by the Thief. All targets within Very Close range of the trap must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (13) or be pulled off their feet and suspended upside down. A target is Restrained and Vulnerable until they break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Finesse or Strength Roll (13).

adversaries.name: Merchant Baron
adversaries.description: An accomplished merchant with a large operation under their command.

features.name: Everyone Has a Price
features.text: Spend a Fear to offer a target a dangerous bargain for something they want or need. If used on a PC, they must make a Presence Reaction Roll (17). On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or take the deal.

features.name: The Best Muscle Money Can Buy
features.text: Once per scene, mark a Stress to summon 1d4+1 Tier 1 adversaries, who appear at Far range, to enforce the Baron’s will.

adversaries.name: Minotaur Wrecker
adversaries.description: A massive bull-headed firbolg with a quick temper.

features.name: Ramp Up
features.text: You must spend a Fear to spotlight the Minotaur. While spotlighted, they can make their standard attack against all targets within range.

features.name: Charging Bull
features.text: Mark a Stress to charge through a group within Close range and make an attack against all targets in the Minotaur’s path. Targets the Minotaur succeeds against take 2d6+8 physical damage and are knocked back to Very Far range. If a target is knocked into a solid object or another creature, they take an extra 1d6 damage (combine the damage).

features.name: Gore
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Very Close range, moving the Minotaur into Melee range of them. On a success, deal 2d8 direct physical damage.

adversaries.name: Mortal Hunter
adversaries.description: An undead figure wearing a heavy leather coat, with searching eyes and a casually cruel demeanor.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Hunter makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Deathlock
features.text: Spend a Fear to curse a target within Very Close range with a necrotic Deathlock until the end of the scene. Attacks made by the Hunter against a Deathlocked target deal direct damage. The Hunter can only maintain one Deathlock at a time.

features.name: Inevitable Death
features.text: Mark a Stress to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Rampage
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Hunter is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, move the Hunter in a straight line to a point within Far range and make an attack against all targets in their path. Targets the Hunter succeeds against take 2d8+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Ravenous Mockery
adversaries.description: A shapeshifting predator that assumes the appearance of inanimate objects to lure unwary prey into its threat range.

features.name: Tongue Attack
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a creature within Close range. On a success, the target is pulled into Melee range with the Mockery and Restrained until they escape with a successful Strength Roll, and you can spend a Fear to activate the Mockery’s Devour feature against the target.

features.name: Devour
features.text: Attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the Mockery Swallows the target. While Swallowed, the target is Restrained and marks a HP when the Mockery is spotlighted. The Mockery disgorges all Swallowed creatures when it takes Major or Severe damage.

features.name: Never Just One
features.text: Spend a Fear to reveal that another object on the battlefield has been a Ravenous Mockery the whole time, then immediately spotlight it.

adversaries.name: Royal Advisor
adversaries.description: A high-ranking courtier with the ear of the local nobility.

features.name: Devastating Retort
features.text: A PC who rolls less than 17 on an action roll targeting the Advisor must mark a Stress.

features.name: Bend Ears
features.text: Mark a Stress to influence an NPC within Melee range with whispered words. That target’s opinion on one matter shifts toward the Advisor’s preference unless it is in direct opposition to the target’s motives.

features.name: Scapegoat
features.text: Spend a Fear to convince a crowd or notable individual that one person or group is responsible for some problem facing the target. The target becomes hostile to the scapegoat until convinced of their innocence with a successful Presence Roll (17).

adversaries.name: Rust Eater
adversaries.description: A pony-sized cockroach coated in a corrosive chitin that turns metal into rust.

features.name: Stifling Pheromones
features.text: A PC who makes an action roll within Very Close range of the Rust Eater must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or mark a Stress.

features.name: Rust Touch
features.text: The Rust Eater’s carapace is coated in a corrosive acid that pits and rusts metal. When a PC within Melee range of the Rust Easter succeeds on an attack against it with a metal weapon, reduce the weapon’s damage die by one step (for example, d8 to d6 or d6 to d4). If a weapon’s damage die is reduced below a d4, the weapon crumbles into rust. The Rust Eater then devours the rust pile and clears a HP.

adversaries.name: Scarecrow
adversaries.description: A bundle of straw bound into a humanoid shape, clothed in rags, and animated by a trapped soul.

features.name: Made of Straw
features.text: The Scarecrow has resistance to physical damage but takes double damage from fire.

features.name: Terror Vision
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Scarecrow lock eyes with a PC within Very Close range, dealing 2d8 magic damage and making them Vulnerable until they roll with Hope.

adversaries.name: Secret-Keeper
adversaries.description: A clandestine leader with a direct channel to the Fallen Gods.

features.name: Seize Your Moment
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to spotlight 1d4 allies. Attacks they make while spotlighted in this way deal half damage.

features.name: Our Master’s Will
features.text: When you spotlight an ally within Far range, mark a Stress to gain a Fear.

features.name: Summoning Ritual
features.text: Countdown (6). When the Secret-Keeper is in the spotlight for the first time, activate the countdown. When they mark HP, tick down this countdown by the number of HP marked. When it triggers, summon a Minor Demon who appears at Close range.

features.name: Fallen Hounds
features.text: Once per scene, when the Secret-Keeper marks 2 or more HP, you can mark a Stress to summon a Demonic Hound Pack, which appears at Close range and is immediately spotlighted.

adversaries.name: Shark
adversaries.description: A large aquatic predator, always on the move.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Rending Bite
features.text: When the Shark makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Blood in the Water
features.text: When a creature within Close range of the Shark marks HP from another creature’s attack, you can mark a Stress to immediately spotlight the Shark, moving them into Melee range of the target and making a standard attack.

adversaries.name: Siren
adversaries.description: A half-fish person with shimmering scales and an irresistible voice.

features.name: Captive Audience
features.text: If the Siren makes a standard attack against a target Entranced by their song, the attack deals 2d10+1 damage instead of their standard damage.

features.name: Enchanting Song
features.text: Spend a Fear to sing a song that affects all targets within Close range. Targets must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or become Entranced until they mark 2 Stress. Other Sirens within Close range of the target can mark a Stress to each add a +1 bonus to the Difficulty of the reaction roll. While Entranced, a target can’t act and is Vulnerable.

adversaries.name: Spectral Archer
adversaries.description: A ghostly fighter with an ethereal bow, unable to move on while their charge is vulnerable.

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Archer has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Pick Your Target
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack within Far range against a PC who is within Very Close range of at least two other PCs. On a success, the target takes 2d8+12 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Spectral Captain
adversaries.description: A ghostly commander leading their troops beyond death.

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Captain has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Unending Battle
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to return up to 1d4+1 defeated Spectral allies to the battle at the points where they first appeared (with no marked HP or Stress).

features.name: Hold Fast
features.text: When the Captain’s Spectral allies are forced to make a reaction roll, you can mark a Stress to give those allies a +2 bonus to the roll.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Captain makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Spectral Guardian
adversaries.description: A ghostly fighter with spears and swords, anchored by duty.

features.name: Ghost
features.text: The Guardian has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Grave Blade
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d10+6 physical damage and the target must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Sprite
adversaries.description: A tiny winged warrior that attacks trespassers with poison-tipped arrows.
motives: let the poison do its work

features.name: Minion (5)
features.text: The Sprite is defeated when they take any damage. For every 5 damage a PC deals to the Sprite, the PC defeats an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Art of Invisibility
features.text: Spend a Fear to make the Sprite Hidden until they attack.

features.name: Dream Petal Poison
features.text: When the Sprite succeeds on a standard attack, you can spend a Fear to make the target Sleepy until the target takes damage. While Sleepy, the target must make a Presence Reaction Roll before they make an action roll. On a failure, they must mark 2 Stress or fall asleep until they take damage.

adversaries.name: Spy
adversaries.description: A skilled espionage agent with a knack for being in the right place to overhear secrets.

features.name: Gathering Secrets
features.text: Spend a Fear to describe how the Spy knows a secret about a PC in the scene.

features.name: Fly on the Wall
features.text: When a PC or group is discussing something sensitive, you can mark a Stress to reveal that the Spy is present in the scene, observing them. If the Spy escapes the scene to report their findings, you gain 1d4 Fear.

adversaries.name: Stone Titan
adversaries.description: A gray-skinned goliath who lives underground and specializes in crafting powerful items inlaid with magical runes.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Skillful Strike
features.text: Before the Titan makes an attack, you can mark a Stress and roll a d6. On a result of 3 or higher, the target’s Evasion is halved against this attack.

features.name: Sunlight Sickness
features.text: When the Titan first appears above ground, roll a d4. Mark a number of Stress equal to the result. The Titan gains a bonus to their attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Stress marked.

features.name: Hammer Smash
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an Armor Slot without gaining its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage).

adversaries.name: Stonewraith
adversaries.description: A prowling hunter, like a slinking mountain lion, with a slate-gray stone body.

features.name: Stonestrider
features.text: The Stonewraith can move through stone and earth as easily as air. While within stone or earth, they are Hidden and immune to all damage.

features.name: Rocky Ambush
features.text: While Hidden, mark a Stress to leap into Melee range with a target within Very Close range. The target must succeed on an Agility or Instinct Reaction Roll (15) or take 2d8 physical damage and become temporarily Restrained.

features.name: Avalanche Roar
features.text: Spend a Fear to roar while within a cave and cause a cave-in. All targets within Close range must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll (14) or take 2d10 physical damage. The rubble can be cleared with a Progress Countdown (8).

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Stonewraith makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Triceratops
adversaries.description: A large dinosaur that has an armored frill and three horns.

features.name: Leathery Hide
features.text: When the Triceratops would be forced to mark HP, you can mark any number of Stress instead of an equal number of HP.

features.name: Tail Swipe
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose up to three targets within Very Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 5d6 physical damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a target within Close range. The Triceratops moves into Melee range with the target and makes an attack. On a success, deal 3d10 direct physical damage.

adversaries.name: Tyrannosaurus
adversaries.description: A huge carnivorous dinosaur that walks on two legs.

features.name: Earth-Shaking Roar
features.text: Spend a Fear to force each PC within Close range to make a Presence Reaction Roll. On a failure, they must choose to lose a Hope or mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Stomp
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 3d12 direct physical damage.

features.name: Crushing Bite
features.text: When the Tyrannosaurus makes a successful standard attack, you can spend a Fear to force the target to mark an additional HP.

adversaries.name: Urco
adversaries.description: A black-furred hound from beyond the veil of death that portends death and feeds on fear.

features.name: Fearmonger
features.text: When a PC within Very Close range fails with Hope, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Terror-Fueled
features.text: The Urco gains a bonus to attack and damage rolls equal to the number of Fear you have.

features.name: Fear Eater
features.text: Spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of Stress. If the Urco has no marked Stress, you can spend any number of Fear to clear the same number of HP.

features.name: Baleful Gaze
features.text: When the Urco takes damage from an attack, you can spend a Fear to cause the attacker’s damage thresholds to gain a -1 penalty until the end of the scene. This effect can stack.

adversaries.name: Valdenhax
adversaries.description: A malevolent forest hag who has long, mossy hair and flies through the air with an oversized mortar and pestle.

features.name: To Me, My Pretties
features.text: Once per scene, summon 2d4 Tier 2 Hordes, which appear at Far range. You gain a Fear for each Horde summoned in this way.

features.name: Shadow Strangler
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Far range. On a success, the shadow of the Valdenhax’s hand stretches across the ground until it grasps the target’s shadow and drains their essence. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and you gain an equal number of Fear.

features.name: Corpse Whisperer
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Valdenhax call out to the lingering spirit of a fallen ally within Close range. Roll a d6. On an even result, the Valdenhax resurrects the ally with half its HP cleared. On an odd result, the Valdenhax absorbs the dregs of its life force and clears a Stress.

features.name: Vexing Word
features.text: After a PC makes a roll, you can mark a Stress to force them to reroll it. This feature can’t be used if the PC critically succeeds.

adversaries.name: War Wizard
adversaries.description: A battle-hardened mage trained in destructive magic.

features.name: Battle Teleport
features.text: Before or after making a standard attack, you can mark a Stress to teleport to a location within Far range.

features.name: Refresh Warding Sphere
features.text: Mark a Stress to refresh the Wizard’s "Warding Sphere" reaction.

features.name: Eruption
features.text: Spend a Fear and choose a point within Far range. A Very Close area around that point erupts into impassable terrain. All targets within that area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (14). Targets who fail take 2d10 physical damage and are thrown out of the area. Targets who succeed take half damage and aren’t moved.

features.name: Arcane Artillery
features.text: Spend a Fear to unleash a precise hail of magical blasts. All targets in the scene must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 2d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Warding Sphere
features.text: When the Wizard takes damage from an attack within Close range, deal 2d6 magic damage to the attacker. This reaction can’t be used again until the Wizard refreshes it with their "Refresh Warding Sphere" action.

adversaries.name: Adult Flickerfly
adversaries.description: A winged insect the size of a large house with iridescent scales and wings that move too fast to track.

features.name: Relentless (4)
features.text: The Flickerfly can be spotlighted up to four times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Never Misses
features.text: When the Flickerfly makes an attack, the target’s Evasion is halved against the attack.

features.name: Deadly Flight
features.text: While flying, the Flickerfly can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action.

features.name: Whirlwind
features.text: Spend a Fear to whirl, making an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Flickerfly succeeds against take 3d8 direct physical damage.

features.name: Mind Dance
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a magically dazzling display that grapples the minds of nearby foes. All targets within Close range must make an Instinct Reaction Roll. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear and the Flickerfly learns one of the target’s fears.

features.name: Hallucinatory Breath
features.text: Countdown (Loop 1d6). When the Flickerfly takes damage for the first time, activate the countdown. When it triggers, the Flickerfly breathes hallucinatory gas on all targets in front of them up to Far range. Targets must make an Instinct Reaction Roll or be tormented by fearful hallucinations. Targets whose fears are known to the Flickerfly have disadvantage on this roll. Targets who fail lose 2 Hope and take 3d8+3 direct magic damage.

features.name: Uncanny Reflexes
features.text: When the Flickerfly takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to take half damage.

adversaries.name: Archmage
adversaries.description: A seeker of secret knowledge hidden away in a tome-filled tower.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Archmage can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Orbiting Aegis
features.text: When the Archmage appears, they conjure six discs of magical energy that orbit around them. Place a d6 Aegis Die on this stat block with the 6 value facing up. When a PC makes a successful attack against the Archmage, roll a d6. If the result is equal to or less than the value of the Aegis Die, tick the Aegis Die down and ignore the damage. A PC can make a Knowledge Roll to tick down the Aegis Die by 1 on a success or by 2 on a success with Hope.

features.name: Force Salvo
features.text: Spend any number of Fear and roll that many d4s. The Archmage unleashes a number of magical homing force bolts equal to the total result. For each bolt, a creature within Far range marks a HP. The same creature can be targeted by up to three force bolts.

features.name: Fireball
features.text: Mark any number of Stress to target the same number of PCs within Far range. Each target must succeed on an Agility Reaction Roll or take 4d10 magic damage.

features.name: Counterspell
features.text: When a PC succeeds on a Spellcast Roll, you can spend a Fear to have the Archmage make a reaction roll with a Difficulty equal to the Spellcast Roll’s result. On a success, the PC’s Spellcast Roll fails instead, and you place a token on this stat block. Using this feature again costs additional Fear equal to the number of tokens on this stat block. You can’t Counterspell a critical success.

adversaries.name: Catrin
adversaries.description: A lavishly adorned skeleton that has an endless appetite for gold.

features.name: Attracted to Wealth
features.text: PCs carrying at least a bag of gold gain advantage on Presence Rolls made to influence the Catrin.

features.name: The Weight of Opulence
features.text: Spend a Fear to turn the Catrin’s gaze toward the PC carrying the most gold. The target must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll or lose a Hope for each bag of gold they’re carrying. If the PC loses their last Hope or has no Hope to lose, they mark Stress instead.

features.name: Expensive Failure
features.text: When a PC within Melee range fails an action roll, you can mark a Stress to have the Catrin brazenly steal a handful of gold from them.

adversaries.name: Chimera
adversaries.description: A giant fire-breathing monster that has a lion’s head, a goat’s body, and a serpent’s tail.

features.name: Rending Jaws
features.text: When the Chimera makes a successful attack against a PC, the target must mark 2 Armor Slots to reduce the severity by one threshold.

features.name: Double Claw
features.text: Mark a Stress to make two standard attacks. If both attacks succeed against the same target, combine the damage.

features.name: Breath of Fire
features.text: Spend a Fear to target up to three PCs in front of the Chimera within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll (20). Targets who fail take 3d12 magic damage. Targets who succeed must choose to mark either an Armor Slot or a Stress.

features.name: Serpent Strike
features.text: When a PC within Close range targets the Chimera with an attack, you can mark a Stress to attack the PC first. On a success, deal 4d4+10 physical damage and Poison them until their next rest or they succeed on a Knowledge Roll (20). While Poisoned, the target must roll a d6 before they make an action roll. On a result of 3 or lower, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Crimson Lepus
adversaries.description: A red-eyed rabbit that thinks only of murder.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Lepus can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: "Awww..."
features.text: When the Lepus first appears, it is Too Cute. To attack a Too Cute creature, a PC must succeed on an Instinct Reaction Roll (20). Clear the Too Cute condition if a PC deals damage to the Lepus or if the Lepus attacks a PC.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Lepus makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Leaping Jugular Strike
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Lepus leap into Melee range of a target within Far range and make an attack against them. On a success, deal 3d20 direct physical damage. If the target marks HP from this attack, they become Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Evasive
features.text: When the Lepus would take damage, roll a d6. On a 4 or higher, halve the damage. If the damage was already halved, the Lepus takes no damage.

features.name: "Run Away!"
features.text: When a PC with no Hope takes the spotlight within Very Far range of the Lepus, the PC must succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or use their action to flee the battlefield until they spend a Hope to return.

adversaries.name: Cryptimoth
adversaries.description: A large red-eyed moth creature that walks upright and portends mysterious or evil events.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Cryptimoth makes a successful attack, all PCs within Close range lose a Hope, and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Psychic Screech
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Cryptimoth unleash a burst of psychic energy that causes each PC within Far range to suffer visions of their horrifying fate. Each target must make an Instinct Reaction Roll (16). Targets who fail take 3d8 direct magic damage and become Vulnerable until their next rest. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress or take half damage.

features.name: Shadow Swarm
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth conjure a swarm of mothlike shadow creatures within Far range. The swarm fills a Close range area and blocks line of sight. Creatures that aren’t Cryptimoths are Vulnerable while inside that area and must mark a Stress to move through it. A PC can dispel the swarm with a successful Spellcast Roll (12).

features.name: Paranoia Glare
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Cryptimoth gaze into the eyes of a PC within Close range and make them Paranoid. While Paranoid, the PC is suspicious of other PCs and can’t Help an Ally or take part in Tag Team Rolls. To clear this condition, the PC must succeed on an Instinct Roll (16) or participate in the Prepare downtime move with one or more members of their party during a rest.

adversaries.name: Cursed Merfolk
adversaries.description: A half-fish, half-human creature psychically bound to serve the Deep Dwellers.

features.name: Fish-Tailed
features.text: The Merfolk is Vulnerable out of the water.

features.name: Gang Up
features.text: The Merfolk gains a +2 bonus to attack rolls against targets within Melee range of one or more allies.

features.name: "Get Over Here!"
features.text: When the Merfolk makes a successful standard attack against a target beyond Melee range, you can mark a Stress to pull them into Melee range. If you do, you can spend a Fear to make a standard attack with advantage against the target.

adversaries.name: Deep Dweller
adversaries.description: A huge psychic lamprey that has pitch-black eyes and toxic tentacles.

features.name: Psychic Blast
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose up to three targets within Close range and force them to make an Instinct or Knowledge Reaction Roll. Targets who succeed mark a Stress. Targets who fail take 3d10+4 direct magic damage and are Vulnerable until spotlighted.

features.name: Brain Drain
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a Vulnerable PC within Very Close range. The target marks 1d4 Stress, and the Deep Dweller clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Call of the Deep
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to summon 1d4 Cursed Merfolk, who appear at Far range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: Mucosal Contamination
features.text: Make an attack roll against a PC within Very Close range. On a success, the Deep Dweller uses its tentacles to immobilize the target, sliming them with toxic sludge. The target is Restrained until they break free or slip out with a successful Strength or Finesse Roll. Each time the Deep Dweller is spotlighted, all PCs Restrained in this way take 3d8 direct physical damage. The Deep Dweller releases all creatures Restrained by it when it’s defeated or takes Severe damage.

adversaries.name: Demon of Avarice
adversaries.description: A regal cloaked monstrosity with circular horns adorned with treasure.

features.name: Money Talks
features.text: Attacks against the Demon are made with disadvantage unless the attacker spends a handful of gold. This Demon starts with a number of handfuls equal to the number of PCs. When a target marks HP from the Demon’s standard attack, they can spend a handful of gold instead of marking HP (1 handful per HP). Add a handful of gold to the Demon for each handful of gold spent by PCs on this feature.

features.name: Numbers Must Go Up
features.text: Add a bonus to the Demon’s attack rolls equal to the number of handfuls of gold they have.

features.name: Money Is Time
features.text: Spend 3 handfuls of gold (or a Fear) to spotlight 1d4+1 allies.

adversaries.name: Demon of Despair
adversaries.description: A cloaked demon-creature with long limbs, seeping shadows.

features.name: Depths of Despair
features.text: The Demon deals double damage to PCs with 0 Hope.

features.name: Your Struggle Is Pointless
features.text: Spend a Fear to weigh down the spirits of all PCs within Far range. All targets affected replace their Hope Die with a d8 until they roll a success with Hope or their next rest.

features.name: Your Friends Will Fail You
features.text: When a PC fails with Fear, you can mark a Stress to cause all other PCs within Close range to lose a Hope.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Demon of Hubris
adversaries.description: A perfectly beautiful and infinitely cruel demon with a gleaming spear and elegant robes.

features.name: Terrifying
features.text: When the Demon makes a successful attack, all PCs within Far range must lose a Hope and you gain a Fear.

features.name: Double or Nothing
features.text: When a PC within Far range fails a roll, they can choose to reroll their Fear Die and take the new result. If they still fail, they mark 2 Stress and the Demon clears a Stress.

features.name: Unparalleled Skill
features.text: Mark a Stress to deal the Demon’s standard attack damage to a target within Close range.

features.name: The Root of Villainy
features.text: Spend a Fear to spotlight two other Demons within Far range.

features.name: You Pale in Comparison
features.text: When a PC fails a roll within Close range of the Demon, they must mark a Stress.

adversaries.name: Demon of Jealousy
adversaries.description: A fickle creature of spindly limbs and insatiable desires.

features.name: Unprotected Mind
features.text: The Demon’s standard attack deals direct damage.

features.name: My Turn
features.text: When the Demon marks HP from an attack, spend a number of Fear equal to the HP marked by the Demon to cause the attacker to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Rivalry
features.text: When a creature within Close range takes damage from a different adversary, you can mark a Stress to add a d4 to the damage roll.

features.name: What’s Yours Is Mine
features.text: When a PC takes Severe damage within Very Close range of the Demon, you can spend a Fear to cause the target to make a Finesse Reaction Roll. On a failure, the Demon seizes one item or consumable of their choice from the target’s inventory.

adversaries.name: Demon of Wrath
adversaries.description: A hulking demon with boulder-sized fists, driven by endless rage.

features.name: Anger Unrelenting
features.text: The Demon’s attacks deal direct damage.

features.name: Battle Lust
features.text: Spend a Fear to boil the blood of all PCs within Far range. They use a d20 as their Fear Die until the end of the scene.

features.name: Retaliation
features.text: When the Demon takes damage from an attack within Close range, you can mark a Stress to make a standard attack against the attacker.

features.name: Blood and Souls
features.text: Countdown (Loop 6). Activate the first time an attack is made within sight of the Demon. It ticks down when a PC takes a violent action. When it triggers, summon 1d4 Minor Demons, who appear at Close range.

adversaries.name: Dire Bat
adversaries.description: A wide-winged pet endlessly loyal to their vampire owner.

features.name: Flying
features.text: While flying, the Bat gains a +3 bonus to their Difficulty.

features.name: Screech
features.text: Mark a Stress to send a high-pitch screech out toward all targets in front of the Bat within Far range. Those targets must mark 1d4 Stress.

features.name: Guardian
features.text: When an allied Vampire marks HP, you can mark a Stress to fly into Melee range of the attacker and make an attack with advantage against them. On a success, deal 2d6+2 physical damage.

adversaries.name: Drake
adversaries.description: A clawed quadruped that has a scaled, serpentine body and a willingness to serve its cousins, the dragons.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Drake can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Guard Dog
features.text: When a PC would deal damage to a creature within Close range, you can mark a Stress to have the Drake move to intercept the attack and take the damage instead. If the attacker is within Melee range of the Drake’s new position, you can immediately spotlight the Drake without spending Fear.

adversaries.name: Dryad
adversaries.description: A nature spirit in the form of a humanoid tree.

features.name: Bramble Patch
features.text: Mark a Stress to target a point within Far range. Create a patch of thorns that covers an area within Close range of that point. All targets within that area take 2d6+2 physical damage when they act. A target must succeed on a Finesse Roll or deal more than 20 damage to the Dryad with an attack to leave the area.

features.name: Grow Saplings
features.text: Spend a Fear to grow three Treant Sapling Minions, who appear at Close range and immediately take the spotlight.

features.name: We Are All One
features.text: When an ally dies within Close range, you can spend a Fear to clear 2 HP and 2 Stress as the fallen ally’s life force is returned to the forest.

adversaries.name: Dullahan
adversaries.description: A horse-mounted specter holding their own severed head in one hand and wielding a whip fashioned from a human spine in the other.

features.name: Specter
features.text: The Dullahan has resistance to physical damage. Mark a Stress to move up to Close range through solid objects.

features.name: Spectral Mount
features.text: While atop their steed, the Dullahan can move up to Far range instead of Close range before taking an action. If the Dullahan is unhorsed, their mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again. The Dullahan is Vulnerable while not on their horse.

features.name: Bone Whip Strike
features.text: Mark a Stress to make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the target takes 4d4+10 direct physical damage and is Vulnerable until they clear a HP.

features.name: Death Glare
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a PC within Far range. The target must make an Presence Reaction Roll (19). On a success, they mark a Stress. On a failure, they mark a HP and activate a Doom Countdown (4). It ticks down when the Dullahan is spotlighted. When it triggers, the target makes a death move. If the Dullahan is defeated or the PCs take a rest, all Doom Countdowns end.

adversaries.name: Fellmounted Shadow King
adversaries.description: The shade of a forgotten ruler, cursed to patrol the skies atop a winged eel in the service of an even greater evil.

features.name: Fellmount
features.text: While the Shadow King is on his mount, he gains a +2 bonus to his Difficulty. When the Shadow King takes Severe damage, he’s knocked from his mount. If the Shadow King is unmounted, his mount disappears until you mark a Stress to summon it again.

features.name: Light and Shadow
features.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls while in shadow or darkness and disadvantage on attack rolls while in bright light.

features.name: Relic Hunter
features.text: The Shadow King has advantage on attack rolls against PCs who have magic weapons or armor equipped.

features.name: Hellsong
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Shadow King’s mount unleash a spine-chilling screech that echoes over the battlefield. Each PC within Far range must make a Presence Reaction Roll (18). Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. Targets who fail must mark a Stress and lose a Hope. If a PC can’t lose a Hope, you gain 2 Fear.

features.name: Air Support
features.text: Three times per scene, you can spend a Fear to have an ally within Far range reroll a failed attack with advantage.

adversaries.name: Elemental Spark
adversaries.description: A blazing mote of elemental fire.

features.name: Minion (9)
features.text: The Elemental is defeated when they take any damage. For every 9 damage a PC deals to the Elemental, defeat an additional Minion within range the attack would succeed against.

features.name: Group Attack
features.text: Spend a Fear to choose a target and spotlight all Elemental Sparks within Close range of them. Those Minions move into Melee range of the target and make one shared attack roll. On a success, they deal 5 physical damage each. Combine this damage.

adversaries.name: Fire Titan
adversaries.description: An armor-clad goliath who has ash-gray skin and fiery hair and wields a masterwork greatsword crafted in their own smithy.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Masterwork Armor
features.text: Countdown (3). When the Titan first appears, activate the countdown. It ticks down when the Titan takes Major or Severe damage. Until the countdown triggers, reduce incoming damage by 1d12. When it triggers, the Titan gains a +1 bonus to their Difficulty and attack rolls.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Titan makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Hurl Rock
features.text: Mark a Stress to choose a point within Far range, then make an attack against all targets between the Titan and that point. Targets the Titan succeeds against take 3d12 physical damage.

features.name: Skull Splitter
features.text: Mark a Stress to place a token on this stat block. The next time the Titan is spotlighted, you must spend the token from this stat block and make an attack against a PC within Close range. On a success, deal 3d20+5 direct physical damage. On a failure, the target marks a Stress.

features.name: Blazing Heart
features.text: When the Titan marks half or more of their HP, you can spend a Fear and mark any number of Stress to clear a number of HP equal to the number of Stress marked.

adversaries.name: Frost Titan
adversaries.description: A blue-skinned goliath who has rimed hair and wears trophies of past battles.

features.name: Relentless (2)
features.text: The Titan can be spotlighted up to two times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: War Horn
features.text: Mark a Stress to force each PC within Far range to succeed on a Presence Reaction Roll or mark a Stress and become Vulnerable until after the next attack against them.

features.name: Bull Rush
features.text: Mark a Stress to move up to Close range and make an attack roll against a target within Melee range. On a success, deal 4d10+2 physical damage and knock the target back to Close range.

features.name: Cleaving Strike
features.text: When a PC marks HP from the Titan’s standard attack, you can mark a Stress to force another PC within Very Close range who the attack would have succeeded against to mark the same number of HP.

features.name: Trophy Hunter
features.text: When the Titan defeats a PC, the Titan takes the PC’s most valuable possession as a trophy.

adversaries.name: Gargantuan Sea Turtle
adversaries.description: A monstrous sea turtle that has an adamantine shell and beak.

features.name: Relentless (3)
features.text: The Turtle can be spotlighted up to three times per GM turn. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight it.

features.name: Piercing Bite
features.text: When the Turtle makes a successful standard attack against a PC, the PC must either mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefit or take double damage.

features.name: Tail Bash
features.text: Mark a Stress to make a standard attack against all PCs behind the Turtle within Very Close range. On a success, a target takes an extra 1d12 physical damage and is pushed away from the Turtle to Close range.

features.name: Gigaton Splash
features.text: Spend a Fear to have the Turtle use its weight to unleash an unstoppable wall of water that targets all creatures within Far range. Each PC must make a Strength Reaction Roll to navigate the tide. Targets who fail are pushed away from the Turtle to Close range, take 4d8 physical damage, and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must mark a Stress. For each target who failed, you gain a Fear.

features.name: Steam Breath
features.text: Spend 2 Fear to have the Turtle release a blast of superheated steam targeting all PCs in front of it within Close range. Each target must make an Agility Reaction Roll. Targets who fail take 4d8 magic damage and become temporarily Vulnerable. Targets who succeed must choose to either mark a Stress or take half damage.

adversaries.name: Greater Earth Elemental
adversaries.description: A living landslide of boulders and dust, as large as a house.

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Elemental and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Elemental and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Crushing Blows
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Immovable Object
features.text: An attack that would move the Elemental moves them two fewer ranges (for example, Far becomes Very Close). When the Elemental takes physical damage, reduce it by 7.

features.name: Rockslide
features.text: Mark a Stress to create a rockslide that buries the land in front of Elemental within Close range with rockfall. All targets in this area must make an Agility Reaction Roll (19). Targets who fail take 2d12+5 physical damage and become Vulnerable until their next roll with Hope. Targets who succeed take half damage.

features.name: Momentum
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful attack against a PC, you gain a Fear.

adversaries.name: Greater Water Elemental
adversaries.description: A huge living wave that crashes down upon enemies.

features.name: Water Jet
features.text: Mark a Stress to attack a target within Very Close range. On a success, deal 2d4+7 physical damage and the target’s next action has disadvantage. On a failure, the target must mark a Stress.

features.name: Drowning Embrace
features.text: Spend a Fear to make an attack against all targets within Very Close range. Targets the Elemental succeeds against become Restrained and Vulnerable as they begin drowning. A target can break free, ending both conditions, with a successful Strength or Instinct Roll.

features.name: High Tide
features.text: When the Elemental makes a successful standard attack, you can mark a Stress to knock the target back to Close range.

adversaries.name: Huge Green Ooze
adversaries.description: A translucent green mound of acid taller than most humans.

features.name: Slow
features.text: When you spotlight the Ooze and they don’t have a token on their stat block, they can’t act yet. Place a token on their stat block and describe what they’re preparing to do. When you spotlight the Ooze and they have a token on their stat block, clear the token and they can act.

features.name: Acidic Form
features.text: When the Ooze makes a successful attack, the target must mark an Armor Slot without receiving its benefits (they can still use armor to reduce the damage). If they can’t mark an Armor Slot, they must mark an additional HP.

features.name: Envelop
features.text: Make an attack against a target within Melee range. On a success, the Ooze Envelops them and the target must mark 2 Stress. While Enveloped, the target must mark an additional Stress every time they make an action roll. When the Ooze takes Severe damage, all Enveloped targets are freed and the condition is cleared.

features.name: Split
features.text: When the Ooze has 4 or more HP marked, you can spend a Fear to split them into two Green Oozes (with no marked HP or Stress). Immediately spotlight both of them.

adversaries.name: Hydra
adversaries.description: A quadrupedal scaled beast with multiple long-necked heads, each filled with menacing fangs.

features.name: Many-Headed Menace
features.text: The Hydra begins with three heads and can have up to five. When the Hydra takes Major or greater damage, they lose a head.

features.name: Relentless (X)
features.text: The Hydra can be spotlighted X times per GM turn, where X is the Hydra’s number of heads. Spend Fear as usual to spotlight them.

features.name: Regeneration
features.text: If the Hydra has any marked HP, spend a Fear to clear a HP and grow two heads.

features.name: Terrifying Chorus
features.text: All PCs within Far range lose 2 Hope.

features.name: Magical Weakness
features.text: When the Hydra takes magic damage, they become Dazed until the next roll with Fear. While Dazed, they can’t use their Regeneration action but are immune to magic damage.

adversaries.name: Lamia
adversaries.description: A snake-tailed humanoid monster who stalks the night to absorb the life energy of sleeping people.

features.name: Constriction
features.text: Mark a Stress to have the Lamia wrap their tail around a PC within Melee range and squeeze. The target must succeed on a Finesse Reaction Roll or become Constricted until the Lamia moves or takes Major or greater damage. While Constricted, the target is Restrained and must mark a Stress when the Lamia takes the spotlight.

features.name: Life Leech
features.text: Mark a Stress to force a Vulnerable or Restrained target within Melee range to mark 1d4-1 HP. The Lamia then clears an equal number of HP.

features.name: Sleep Toxin
features.text: When the Lamia makes a successful standard attack against a PC, you can spend a Fear to make them Vulnerable until they succeed on a Instinct Roll (19).
